svg.title: One Cohort From Sourced Opportunity to Cleared Settlement
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-qualified-opportunity-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: One Cohort From Sourced Opportunity to Cleared Settlement; subtitle: Nested counts preserve the same opportunity unit throughout.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative 90-day observation of 200 opportunities sourced in one intake window; an opportunity is one proposed order or allocation lot, not a ticket, person or dollar. Later stages are subsets of earlier stages. First-deal planning remains one to three months.; caption: Twenty-four settled opportunities represent 12% of the original cohort; unsettled purchases remain exposure rather than realized wins.; stages: label: Sourced opportunities; value: 200 proposed order or allocation lots; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Log 200 distinct opportunities with seller identity, inventory description, expected settlement terms and source evidence; remove duplicates before measuring conversion.; label: Verified counterparties and rights; value: 120 verified lots from the original cohort; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Retain 120 opportunities after counterparty, transfer-right, issuer-eligibility and purchase-limit checks; this is 60% of sourced opportunities.; label: Accepted commercial terms; value: 60 documented commitments from verified opportunities; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Obtain accepted order terms or allocation agreements for 60 opportunities, representing 50% of verified opportunities and 30% of the original cohort.; label: Purchased and delivered; value: 30 funded commitments with delivery evidence; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Fund and deliver 30 committed opportunities after cash coverage checks; this is 50% of documented commitments and 15% of sourced opportunities.; label: Cleared and reconciled; value: 24 completed settlements with matched ledger entries; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Reconcile cleared settlement for 24 delivered opportunities, or 80% of delivered lots. Keep the remaining six in receivable aging without assuming they are losses.

text.title: One Cohort From Sourced Opportunity to Cleared Settlement
text.tspan: One Cohort From Sourced Opportunity to Cleared Settlement

circle.title: label: Sourced opportunities; value: 200 proposed order or allocation lots; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Log 200 distinct opportunities with seller identity, inventory description, expected settlement terms and source evidence; remove duplicates before measuring conversion.

label: Verified counterparties and rights; value: 120 verified lots from the original cohort; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Retain 120 opportunities after counterparty, transfer-right, issuer-eligibility and purchase-limit checks; this is 60% of sourced opportunities.

label: Accepted commercial terms; value: 60 documented commitments from verified opportunities; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Obtain accepted order terms or allocation agreements for 60 opportunities, representing 50% of verified opportunities and 30% of the original cohort.

label: Purchased and delivered; value: 30 funded commitments with delivery evidence; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Fund and deliver 30 committed opportunities after cash coverage checks; this is 50% of documented commitments and 15% of sourced opportunities.

label: Cleared and reconciled; value: 24 completed settlements with matched ledger entries; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Reconcile cleared settlement for 24 delivered opportunities, or 80% of delivered lots. Keep the remaining six in receivable aging without assuming they are losses.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative 90-day observation of 200 opportunities sourced in one intake window; an opportunity is one proposed order or allocation lot, not a ticket, person or dollar. Later stages are subsets of earlier stages. First-deal planning remains one to three months.
